ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to Prevent changing of customer on existing ML relationship records
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Customer__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer cannot be changed on existing relationship records
